notes: Ballot reference data (docs/ballot-implementation-plan-2026-09-24.md §5.1). 'supported' states carry person-checked dates and links; every other state is 'links_only': the election date plus its own election office's official pages (registration, mail or absentee voting, polling places, ballot tracking), with no dates. Vote.gov in links_only below is the fallback for a state without its own links. Territories are absent on purpose: Ballot hides there. Release check 1: a person opens every url below before ballot_p0 is enabled. Per supported state: fips (the state's FIPS code, so a boundary lookup that lands in another state is refused); timezone_overrides (a county or place that keeps another clock than the state: dates and cutoffs are read on the voter's local clock); consolidated_counties (a county that is one government with its city: counted once, under the given name); dependent_schools (the state or a county runs the schools, so they are not counted as a separate government).

links_only.note: Pantopus doesn’t have this state’s deadlines yet. Its election office does.
